execution_policy.turn_splitting: Each R47-T1…T12 is a separate conversation/work session with one bounded objective. Do not bundle L2/L3/L4/L5/L6 into one turn. The user can resume by naming the exact turn id.
execution_policy.mutation: Branch-only; never merge to main without explicit separate instruction.
execution_policy.raw_data: Never commit raw maps, catalogues, chains or large proprietary/third-party inputs.
execution_policy.claim_firewall: No observed-data or Bianchi-family claim before source-byte, likelihood, convergence, matched-null and adversarial gates pass.
execution_policy.native_subagents: NOT_RUN in authoring host: no native spawn/wait tools were exposed. The local agent may execute the work packet on the user's workstation.

turns.title: Research checkpoint and solver-free route selection
scope: PR #565-#570 metadata and selected source documents
acceptance: Current parent SHA recorded
Claims separated from execution state
No observed-data result invented

turns.title: Relevance-indexed historical PR and legacy source audit
scope: R32-R39 low-ell, CMB, dipole and five-variable source records
K1 FFP10/NPIPE blocker and download guide
turns.method: Audit PRs by relevance and dependency, not by blind enumeration of unrelated history; record every source path, blob SHA, reused claim and disposition.
acceptance: Every reused claim links to exact source commit/blob
Superseded and quarantined results remain labelled
No duplicate likelihood contribution from repeated derived summaries
R42/R46 parent chain reconciled
stop_conditions: Stop a source lane if its blob cannot be fetched; mark BLOCKED and continue independent lanes
Do not infer a PR is merged from its branch existence

turns.title: Constructive derivation and adversarial check of Bianchi-I geodesic temperature map
outputs: CAS or exact symbolic receipt if available
acceptance: Derive E^2=g^{ij}p_i p_j from conserved covariant spatial momenta
Verify equation (2.1) in METHODS_NO_BOLTZMANN.md
Check B=0, small-B, parity, rotation and positive definiteness
Separate integrated B_* from present shear sigma(t0)
Independent derivation or risk-bounded adversarial review
stop_conditions: If the last-scattering surface cannot be treated as isotropic under declared assumptions, report the precise missing source term; do not patch with an arbitrary transfer factor

turns.title: Implement map/harmonic response and low-ell Gaussian likelihood
acceptance: No production hardcoded response coefficients
No fake T/E/B transfer
Input/output units and frame metadata explicit
Masked harmonic covariance not treated as diagonal
Small fixture likelihood matches direct Gaussian/pixel oracle
R42 source adapters read before extending; no duplicate wrapper API
stop_conditions: Keep E/B as unavailable in the Bianchi-I geodesic-only model
No Bianchi-V/VIIh extrapolation from the Bianchi-I map

turns.title: Acquire and verify Planck PR4/NPIPE plus matched controls
acceptance: Exact source URLs/release/filenames/bytes/SHA256
Map units, nside, ordering, frame, calibration and beam convention checked
Masks and effective transfer matched
Frequency split independence and shared-sky dependence documented
E-mode low-ell transfer suppression calibrated
stop_conditions: If full matched E2E simulations are unavailable, keep empirical null/FPR calibration BLOCKED while allowing a clearly labelled conditional map likelihood
Never mix PR3/FFP10 and PR4/NPIPE as one matched ensemble

turns.title: Observed CMB likelihood, Cobaya sampling and calibration
acceptance: Raw input hashes and source ids match manifest
rank-normalized split-Rhat and bulk/tail ESS thresholds predeclared and passed
trace/rank/multimodal diagnostics archived
SBC and coverage pass under model-matched prior predictive draws
PPC and frequency/split robustness executed
No likelihood factor double-counts the same map or derived summaries
stop_conditions: Do not call an underpowered chain converged
Do not use C_ell-only Blackwell-Rao likelihood to claim phase/morphology inference
If a simulation family is missing, do not publish a calibrated anomaly probability

turns.title: L2 — Quasar and radio-source dipole anomaly
turns.target: Separate kinematic observer contribution from intrinsic clustering/selection dipoles as a function of redshift, flux and tracer.
acceptance: Source-level selection response derived from parent catalogues
Matched random/Poisson and local-structure mocks
No fixed rescaling between magnitude/flux cuts
Held-out tracer or cut predictive check
No intrinsic/global interpretation from a dipole alone

scope: CF4 only if original distance law is qualified
turns.target: Estimate only nuisance-projected identifiable functionals of theta=(sigma_ab, omega_a, A_a, beta_RM, beta_MO).
acceptance: Full source-level covariance, not only precomputed VSH coefficients
External spin-tie availability recorded
Jacobian/Fisher evaluated after shared nuisance projection
Null/kernel directions preserved
No Gaia B1-to-vorticity promotion without frame anchor

turns.title: L5 — Direction-dependent Hubble expansion and distance jets
scope: CF4 original distance data if qualified
DESI BAO only as isotropic background control
Loop-E local optical coefficients and finite-z remainder
turns.target: Estimate h0(n), h1(n), and only the higher distance coefficients supported by the data.
acceptance: Full covariance and stable row identity
Magnitude likelihood used without unjustified Gaussian distance transform
Finite-redshift validity domain and remainder declared
Expansion monopole/dipole/STF quadrupole separated
No use of isotropic compressed BAO to claim a preferred axis

turns.title: L6 — Local observer boost versus global radiation-matter tilt
scope: L3 Gaia E1 with frame calibration
turns.target: Determine whether beta_MO and beta_RM are separately identifiable or only a quotient/combination is supported.
acceptance: Same-state physical frame chain documented
Shared response evaluated at actual source redshift windows
Nuisance-projected rank and singular values reported
Held-out probe/depth prediction and matched mocks
No global-tilt claim from single dipole alignment

turns.title: L4 — Anisotropy classification and Bianchi geometry compatibility
scope: external Bianchi V/VIIh transfer only if verified
turns.target: Classify which geometric families are compatible with the common kinematic/optical/CMB identified set and determine whether any family response is globally separating.
acceptance: Jacobi and Hamiltonian/momentum constraints enforced
Spatial Ricci distinguished from temperature quadrupole and optical shear
Bianchi-I template not promoted to VIIh/V
Any external provider pinned and independently benchmarked
Family ID only after global nuisance-projected image separation

turns.title: Two-layer model × readout adversarial benchmark
acceptance: All models use same data and applicable common subset
Generative model and readout method are separate axes
Proper likelihood/prior/evidence requirements met
The five-variable bundle remains one joint push-forward
HTT is allowed to lose on calibration or prediction

turns.title: Bounded independent review, publication decision and handoff
acceptance: One bounded independent review pass
Empirical and methods tracks adjudicated separately
All claims linked to source/code/data/run identities
NOT_RUN and failed gates explicit
Next continuation point and exact commands preserved

global_stop_conditions: Never claim a physical parameter is identified from a rank result before nuisance projection and global response-equivalence checks.
Never call the full pipeline calibrated without the exact end-to-end null and held-out injections.
Never replace a missing source with fabricated constants, synthetic observations or hardcoded response factors.
Never infer current sigma(t0) from the integrated metric B_* without an admitted dynamical history.
Never count T/Q/U maps, component maps, split maps, a_lm and their deterministic summaries as independent sky realizations.
Never change source release, mask, multipole set, prior, data row order, target estimand or alpha after observing results without a new versioned analysis.

acceptance_policy.empirical_claim: Requires raw-source byte lock, exact forward/observation operator, admitted likelihood law, converged sampler, matched calibration and adversarial model comparison.
acceptance_policy.method_claim: Requires complete mathematical contract, demonstrated implementation, comparative information/calibration results, and independent review.
acceptance_policy.family_identification: Requires global family separation on the physical/observable quotient plus validated geometry-specific forward map, nuisance control and held-out calibration.
